name: tdx-stock-hunter
description: A-share intelligent stock screener powered by TDX MCP data, converting natural language into multi-dimensional screening criteria with scoring and ranking.

displayDescription.en: Powered by TDX MCP data, converts natural language into multi-dimensional screening criteria, performs cross-sectional analysis of 5000+ A-shares across fundamental/technical/capital/valuation dimensions with scoring, for user self-reference and decision making.
displayDescription.zh: 基于通达信MCP数据，将自然语言转为多维筛选条件，从5000+A股中按基本面/技术面/资金面/估值做横向分析与综合评分，供用户参考。
